summary: The note is a short Wikipedia-style overview of the 2017 Los Angeles Chargers season. It describes this as the franchise's 48th NFL season and 58th overall, the first under head coach Anthony Lynn. It explains that the team exercised its option to move to Los Angeles, joining the Los Angeles Rams, on January 12, 2017, and that the season will be the first of three played at StubHub Center before a new stadium opens.
one_line: Overview of the Los Angeles Chargers' 2017 NFL season, their first in Los Angeles under head coach Anthony Lynn.
key_facts: The 2017 Los Angeles Chargers season is the franchise's 48th season in the National Football League (NFL).
The 2017 season is the 58th overall season for the Chargers franchise.
Anthony Lynn is the head coach of the Chargers in the 2017 season, his first with the team.
The 2017 season is the first Chargers season in Los Angeles since their inaugural 1960 season.
The Chargers were in the American Football League (AFL) during their inaugural 1960 season.
The Chargers exercised their option to move to Los Angeles and join the Los Angeles Rams on January 12, 2017.
The 2017 season will be the first of three seasons played at StubHub Center.
StubHub Center will host the Chargers for three seasons prior to the new stadium being completed.
